name: What We Were Wolf
source:
Aubrie Blake breaks free of a torn and tattered identity with the help of a friend, Kinna Mini!

An outlet to capture the thoughts and feelings that have been swirling in my mind lately. Inspired by personal events. A brief 10 minute dive into a light romance, and trying something new!

[From [url=https://shapeshiftgl.itch.io/wwwwolf]Itch.io[/url]]
